law: Every row is labeled IN-BOUND (the bound fires) or KNOWN-MISS (the bound stays silent and chamber/E1-BOUND-RATIFICATION.md names the row as a miss put to John). A row that is neither is a gate failure by name (E1-SILENT-OUT-OF-BOUND), enforced by chamber_e1_bound.bound_problems. The set is COMMITTED: it may only change together with a new F7 amendment.
reference: moment tags cite the Stage-2 Fable-driver reference-session journal (the steward-assessment reference behavior); 'synthetic' rows are constructed forms. No host paths ride this file.
